file.content:
# deploy-tools

Deployment helpers for the internal services.

`bin/notify-deploy.sh SERVICE VERSION` restarts the service on the deploy host and posts a
message to the release channel. The webhook URL comes from `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` in the
environment; per-service settings live in `etc/services.conf`.

#!/bin/bash
# Restart a service on the deploy host and announce the release.

set -e

DRY_RUN=0
args=()
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
    *) args+=("$arg") ;;
  esac
done
set -- "${args[@]}"

SERVICE=$1
VERSION=$2
NOTE=$3

REMOTE_HOST=deploy@deploy.example.internal
SLACK_URL=$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL

. etc/services.conf

# Per-service override, for example CONFIG_web=/etc/web/deploy.conf
eval "CONFIG=\$CONFIG_$SERVICE"

echo "deploying $SERVICE $VERSION with $CONFIG"

# Escapes backslashes, quotes and control characters so NOTE can't break out of the JSON string.
json_escape() {
  local s=$1
  s=${s//\\/\\\\}
  s=${s//\"/\\\"}
  s=${s//$'\n'/\\n}
  s=${s//$'\r'/\\r}
  s=${s//$'\t'/\\t}
  printf '%s' "$s"
}

MESSAGE=$(json_escape "Deployed $SERVICE $VERSION by $USER")
if [ -n "$NOTE" ]; then
  MESSAGE="$MESSAGE $(json_escape " - $NOTE")"
fi

REMOTE_CMD="sudo systemctl restart $SERVICE && /usr/local/bin/deploy $SERVICE $VERSION"

if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "[dry-run] would run: ssh $REMOTE_HOST \"$REMOTE_CMD\""
  echo "[dry-run] would post to Slack: $MESSAGE"
else
  ssh $REMOTE_HOST "$REMOTE_CMD"

  curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
    -d "{\"text\": \"$MESSAGE\"}" $SLACK_URL
fi

`bin/notify-deploy.sh SERVICE VERSION [NOTE]` restarts the service on the deploy host and posts a
message to the release channel. The webhook URL comes from `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` in the
environment; per-service settings live in `etc/services.conf`.

`NOTE` is optional and is appended to the Slack message as a short release note, e.g.
`bin/notify-deploy.sh web 1.4.0 "fixes checkout timeout"`.

Pass `--dry-run` (anywhere in the arguments) to print the ssh command and Slack message that
would be sent without restarting the service or posting to Slack.
